apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App Store URLs (https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/spotify/id324684580), numeric app IDs (324684580), or app names to search for (e.g. 'Monzo').

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter App Store country codes. Reviews are per country, so add several to get more (e.g. us, gb, ca, au, ie).

maxReviewsPerCountry.title: Max reviews per app per country
maxReviewsPerCountry.description: Apple's public feed exposes up to the 500 most recent reviews per country.

ratings.title: Only these star ratings
ratings.description: e.g. 1, 2 to collect only negative reviews. Empty = all.

includeAppDetails.title: Add app details to each review
includeAppDetails.description: App name, developer, average rating, rating count, price and genre.
